violation_type.title: Naptime for Infants - Auditory or visual awareness (26 TAC §747.2324(2))
violation_type.short_title: Naptime for Infants - Auditory or visual awareness
violation_type.typical_finding: The volume on the baby monitor was turned off.

finding_variants.text: The volume on the baby monitor was turned off.

An infant was put down for nap in a back bedroom.  The monitoring that was being used to see and hear the infant was in butler's pantry of the home and volume was muted.    Photo taken of the monitor.

An infant was repeatedly put down for nap in a back bedroom.  The monitoring that was being used to see and hear the infant was in butler's pantry of the home and volume down on one.    Photo taken of the placement of the monitor.
A 12 month old was sleeping in the master bedroom in a pack and play with the door closed. The child was removed from the room during the inspection.
